class Brand {
  static #tag = 1;
  static property(value: typeof Brand | { other: string }): string {
    if (#tag in value) return "own";
    return value.other.toUpperCase();
  }
  static negated(value: typeof Brand | { other: number }): string {
    if (!(#tag in value)) return value.other.toFixed();
    return "own";
  }
  static inherited(value: typeof Child): number {
    if (#tag in value) return value.#tag;
    return value.other;
  }
}
class Child extends Brand {
  static other = 2;
}
Brand.property(Child);
Brand.negated(Child);
Brand.inherited(Child);
